description: This file implements a gateway handler for browser requests, managing communication with browser nodes or a browser control service, including request validation, node resolution, proxy handling, and error management.

methods.name: isBrowserNode
methods.description: Checks if a NodeSession has browser capabilities based on its 'caps' or 'commands' properties.

methods.name: normalizeNodeKey
methods.description: Normalizes a string to a lowercase alphanumeric-only key for comparison.

methods.name: resolveBrowserNode
methods.description: Finds a unique browser node matching a query string among a list of nodes, throws error if ambiguous.

methods.name: resolveBrowserNodeTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target browser node based on configuration policy and connected nodes.

methods.name: persistProxyFiles
methods.description: Persists proxy files using external API.

methods.name: applyProxyPaths
methods.description: Applies path mappings to the proxy result.

methods.name: handleBrowserGatewayRequest
methods.description: Main handler for processing browser gateway requests, including validation, node resolution, proxy invocation, and fallback to browser control service.
